message: Thank you for the opportunity. We propose a 10-year full-scope LTSA (repairs, engines, rotables) with a year-1 fee of $8.0M, hybrid pricing (half fixed, half tied to actual running hours), 3% annual escalation, 96.5% availability guarantee, and a 15% penalty cap. We're happy to discuss adjustments to fit your mid-merit operating profile.

Thanks for the proposal, but $8.0M a year is well outside what we can approve. We can work with a 5-year full-scope LTSA (repairs, engines, rotables) with lease engine included, hybrid pricing, 2% escalation, 98% availability guarantee, 30% penalty cap, and a year-1 fee of $4.2M. That keeps the scope you want and gives us a deal that clearly beats our alternative. Let us know if you can meet these terms.

We understand budget constraints and want to get to a deal. The 98% guarantee with a 30% penalty cap and a lease engine is more exposure than our rules allow, so we can't accept that combination. We can offer a 5-year full-scope LTSA at $5.0M year-1 fee, hybrid pricing, 2% escalation, 96.5% availability, 15% penalty cap, and no lease engine. This keeps the scope you want at a level we can stand behind.

We can't accept $5.0M without the lease engine, since it's a key part of our downtime exposure. Our counter: 5-year full-scope LTSA, $4.5M year-1 fee, hybrid, 2% escalation, 97% availability, 20% penalty cap, with lease engine included. That's a reasonable middle ground on risk, and it keeps us within budget and above our alternative.

We want to meet you on the lease engine, which is important to you. Our revised offer: 5-year LTSA covering repairs and rotables (engine overhaul scope excluded), lease engine included, $4.5M year-1 fee, hybrid pricing, 2% escalation, 97% availability, and a 10% penalty cap. This gives you the downtime protection you care about while keeping the terms within what we can support.

Thanks for moving on the lease engine, but dropping engine coverage removes most of the value we need; our downtime risk sits in engine overhauls. We need engines in scope. Our counter is the full-scope 5-year LTSA (repairs, engines, rotables) with lease engine, $4.5M year-1, hybrid, 2% escalation, 97% availability, and a 20% penalty cap. If you can't meet that, we'll have to weigh our alternatives.

We have to keep engines in scope as you require, but the economics at $4.5M don't work for a full-scope deal. Our best offer: full-scope 5-year LTSA (repairs, engines, rotables) with lease engine, $5.3M year-1 fee, hybrid, 2% escalation, 96.5% availability, and a 15% penalty cap. This is the most we can move while staying within our margin and rules, and it gives you full engine coverage plus lease engine protection.

$5.3M is over our approval limit of $5.0M, so we can't accept it. Our best counter is the full-scope 5-year LTSA with lease engine at $5.0M year-1, hybrid, 2% escalation, 96.5% availability, and a 15% penalty cap. That is the most we can approve, and it's still a deal we'd sign today.

We're close. Our offer: 5-year LTSA with repairs, engines and lease engine included, rotables excluded, $5.0M year-1 fee, hybrid pricing, 2% escalation, 96.5% availability, and a 15% penalty cap. Rotables are the piece we can carve out while keeping engine coverage and the lease engine you need for downtime. This meets our margin and rule requirements.

Dropping rotables takes this offer below our alternative (negative savings for us), so we can't accept it. We've moved a long way, but at $5.0M the full-scope package with lease engine is the only version that works for us. We'll pursue our alternative provider.
